players.product: large-megawatt diesel and gas backup generator sets (with in-house Enercon enclosures/packaging) for hyperscale and colocation data centers

connects_to.relationship: backup power generators for Amazon data centers (long-term supply agreement)

contracts.signal: On September 16, 2026 Generac and Amazon entered into a Transaction Agreement and executed a long-term supply agreement for backup power generators for Amazon data centers. Initial deliveries of backup generators are expected to total $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028. The filing ties the vesting of a warrant issued to an Amazon subsidiary to aggregate gross payments (net of certain offsets) received by Generac from or on behalf of Amazon for backup power generators for Amazon data centers, up to a total of $8 billion.
